item.title: Cabrillo College Governing Board moves to block ICE from campus
item.description: The Cabrillo College Governing Board passed a resolution prohibiting immigration enforcement operations from using its campuses or any of its facilities for processing or operations at its meeting this week

item.title: Member of Trump’s Religious Liberty Commission ousted in dispute over antisemitism
item.description: The ousted member, Carrie Prejean Boller, had defended commentator Candace Owens.

item.title: Former USC assistant, Menlo head coach Todd Hollenbeck takes over at Pacific Collegiate | Boys vollleyball
item.description: Pacific Collegiate School, one of the nation's top-ranked public charter schools, academically, made a splash with its latest addition to its athletics department.

item.title: Dan Haifley, Ocean Currents | The USS Macon’s watery grave
item.description: "Work on the USS Macon site is just one example of efforts to preserve, investigate and inform the public about maritime heritage within our ocean and Great Lakes waters," writes columnist Dan Haifley.

item.title: Photos | Rain clouds return to Santa Cruz County
item.description: After a sunny day on Friday the National Weather Service forecast calls for the rain to return Saturday night and last until at least Wednesday of next week.

item.title: Photos | Cycling on the Santa Cruz Bikeway
item.description: The Santa Cruz Bikeway is an 11-mile, segmented bike route created by Ecology Action, a local nonprofit environmental consultancy that specializes in implementing climate-friendly programs, sustainable transportation and energy efficiency.

item.title: Coast Line | Apply to serve as Santa Cruz County Youth Poet Laureate
item.description: The Santa Cruz Public Libraries has announced that applications are now open to serve as the county’s third Youth Poet Laureate. In partnership with Urban Word, Santa Cruz County Office of Education, Rotary Club of Santa Cruz and Arts Council Santa Cruz County, this initiative celebrates the vibrant world of youth poetry and offers young poets a cross-county community.

item.title: ACC basketball: Cal suffers 107-100 road loss to Syracuse in double overtime
item.description: Syracuse opened double overtime on an 8-2 spurt to outlast Cal in New York on Wednesday night.
